items.title: Keralam Assembly passes resolution seeking CEC Gyanesh Kumar's removal
items.summary: Keralam Assembly passed a resolution (moved by CM V.D. Satheesan, backed by LDF; only BJP's 3 MLAs opposed) seeking Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar's removal over alleged SIR irregularities. Three demands: rectify SIR irregularities, restore voting rights of wrongfully excluded voters, and initiate CEC removal proceedings; it also calls for reconstituting the Election Commission selection panel to comprise the PM, Leader of Opposition (Lok Sabha) and CJI. Satheesan: 'Keralam makes history' — first such resolution by the state Assembly.
